VERDICT goal: the node's goal is that a coordinator re-dispatch of a still-queued request steers it without losing its identity, and reckon/crew/runs.py:694 `_merged_requeue` plus its call at runs.py:803 merge the new record over the waiting pointer at the top level and inside `node`, keeping argv, base_sha, the observed session_id and node.manifest_path.
VERDICT done_when: §17's four cases are each a test in tests/test_a_redispatch_keeps_the_queued_identity.py (lines 152, 173, 206, 220); the gate names that file, the manifest records 4 passed EXIT=0, and I re-ran it at 1afb7ef and got 4 passed.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/runs.py, tests/test_a_redispatch_keeps_the_queued_identity.py and the docs/evidence fragment; the diff touches runs.py, the new test and the fragment, and leaves the worktree clean.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the gate command verbatim, the negative control (1 failed, 3 passed, EXIT=1, KeyError 'argv'), the repro, both importer arms and from where, and states no added failure id.
VERDICT diff: read both commits against base 695f6616 — 3f039a27 adds `_REQUEUE_PRESERVED_NODE_FIELDS`, `_merged_requeue` and its one call site plus the test, and 1afb7ef24c only updates the evidence fragment's measure paragraph to carry both arm counts.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:427 (_answer_existing_node_run), reckon/crew/dispatch.py:275, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1969, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2311, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2383, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:460, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:703
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/runs.py:803 now writes `_merged_requeue(current, record)` where the whole record was written before, so every field the waiting pointer alone carries survives and every steer field wins.
SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: logs/after-suite.log records "4 passed" and EXIT=0 for the named gate, logs/head-importers.log and logs/baseline-suite.log record 1 failed of 183 at head against 2 failed of 183 at base over the same 29 files, so added_failure_ids is empty; I re-ran the single gate test at head and confirmed 4 passed.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/crew/runs.py, tests/test_a_redispatch_keeps_the_queued_identity.py, docs/evidence/fragments/.../a-redispatch-keeps-the-queued-identity.html) is inside the declared write paths, and dispatch.py needed no edit because dispatch.py:427 already hands the record to queue_dispatch.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_redispatch_keeps_the_queued_identity.py:161 asserts the seeded argv survives, which the negative-control log shows reddens with KeyError 'argv' when the whole-record overwrite is restored; the third case's assertions would also pass on the pre-change code, so it guards the spec's stated case rather than the regression.
SCORE fit: 20
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/crew/runs.py:686 carries the reason for the one preserved field as a named constant rather than an enumeration, matching the module's existing style of a constant beside its user and a mechanism-stating docstring.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: no pointer-record merge owner exists; the nearest mechanism, runs.py:371 `_mutate_pointer`, takes a mutation callable and its own per-run lock, which queue_dispatch already holds at runs.py:795, so wrapping it would have deadlocked, and the new helper is a pure function with no forked capability; the test reuses the dispatch fixtures in tests/test_dispatch_names_its_backend.py rather than forking a harness.
